metadata_scope_note: experiment.json describes the original full 400-update mixed-mass run. original_training_completed.json records its later final policy, not this intermediate checkpoint. This selection record gives the actual checkpoint iteration and budget; preserve the original records without rewriting history.
limitations: Single continued training seed11, fixed friction and only three evaluated load points; no pushes or payload-relative-pose perturbation.
Seed5011 evaluation was used for model selection and is not an untouched final test set. Seed6011 provides an additional initial-state-seed check, not broad robustness validation.
Improved foot flatness does not imply a symmetric pose or improved trunk tilt; matched CPU mean trunk tilt increases from2.646deg to4.136deg.
No real-robot deployment interface or safety validation.
evaluation_split_note: Seed5011 was used for selecting model_1450 after comparing candidate checkpoints. Seed6011 was run after selecting this checkpoint. Both use the same three fixed masses and are not independent training-seed replications.
